name: Trapper
theme: Apotheosis of the Setup Master. Prep the encounter before it starts; watch the chain detonate; arm twice as often, escalate per hit.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Traps gain +2 arming count. Multi-trap chains deal escalating damage per hit.'
Pairs with hunter.json trapper path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Snare Field + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Cooldown Mastery.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 5 of 8 wireable today — trap-event nodes (Multi-Arming / Heavy Trap / Snare Field capstone) are decorative until Phase F lands the trap mechanic + onTrapDetonate dispatch. Bleed and Mark conditionals + cooldown recovery work.

nodes.name: Trapper's Hand
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25% damage to Bleeding enemies (foundation — trap detonations stack bleed via §8.3 ailment baseline).

nodes.name: Quick Reload
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% cooldown recovery (foundation — traps live on cooldowns; faster reset = more chains).

nodes.name: Snare Sense
nodes.description: +1/2/3% crit chance (foundation — primer for trap-detonation crits).

nodes.name: Multi-Arming
nodes.description: Traps have +1/2/3/4/5% chance to arm a second time on detonation (Snare Field preview).

nodes.name: Trap Trigger
nodes.description: On hit, +5% chance to apply Bleed (cross-skill bleed applier — feeds the Bleeding-vulnerability stack).

nodes.name: Cooldown Mastery
nodes.description: +2/4/6% cooldown recovery (deeper trap-cycling — stacks with Quick Reload).

nodes.name: Snare Field
nodes.description: Traps gain +2 arming counts (default 1). Multi-trap chains deal escalating damage per hit (1×, 1.5×, 2×, 2.5×). The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
